meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能操控浏览器替你完成打开网页、点击、填写表单、截取屏幕、读取页面文本等操作，并汇报结果。
howto.when: 当你提出打开网页、填写表单、截图等浏览器相关需求时，Claude 会调用这个技能来操作浏览器。

say.text: 打开 example.com，把页面标题告诉我
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并返回标题。

say.text: 在登录表单里填 user@test.com，然后点提交
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框和按钮完成操作。

say.text: 截取当前页面的完整截图
say.note: 会生成整页 PNG 图片。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a browser to open pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, read page text, and report the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to open a webpage, fill a form, take a screenshot, or make other browser-related requests.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title.
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and returns the title.

say_en.text: Fill in user@test.com in the login form and submit it.
say_en.note: Claude locates the fields and performs the action.

say_en.text: Take a full screenshot of the current page.
